message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.

hold_reason: Alpha Co's refund work is incomplete. W2 reported that the refund for order 134 (amount_cents 8998) failed with a disk I/O error and was not recorded, and list_refunds confirms only orders 130 (8178) and 133 (6783) are in the ledger. Paying net balances now would overpay the customer for order 134. Holding for human review: Alpha needs to re-apply the order 134 refund before payouts run.

reply.thought: W2's report says order 134's refund failed and was not recorded, so Alpha's refund work is incomplete. I'll check the ledger directly before deciding whether to hold.

The ledger confirms only orders 130 and 133 have refunds recorded. Order 134's refund ($89.98) is missing, so any payout for its customer would be overstated, and payouts can't be recalled. Alpha's refund work is incomplete, so I'll hold the batch.
